approved: Automatically select the first available competition on entry. Browse ten questions per page; pagination follows the last question and resets scroll to the top. Select one option and explicitly submit with Answer. Correct and incorrect feedback identifies the correct choice and, when wrong, the user's choice. A confirmed answer is read-only on the current page. Changing page or competition, or closing the application, discards responses. On submission failure keep the choice and allow another submission; prevent duplicates while pending. Retry reloads a failed question list. A Ghost sidebar trigger is available across workspace states. On desktop, the collapse and expand icons remain visible at pointer rest with no button background (Ghost). Hover adds subtle surface feedback and keyboard focus adds a visible outline without moving the layout. Activation, not hover, expands the sidebar. Keep the same visible accessible trigger on touch/no-hover devices. Collapse/expand preserves current page, selection, scroll context and answers. Questions follow original exam order. If no competitions are available, show an empty-state message without an action button. On phones, navigation opens as a drawer over the question content rather than shifting it. If competition-list loading fails, show an error and manual Retry. If an answer outcome cannot be confirmed, retain the selected option and permit a safe retry without duplicate evaluation. Support the application interface in Brazilian Portuguese and English.

notes.information-architecture:
**Current workspace — v0.1.0**
One destination: competition sidebar and scrolling question list. Original exam order; 10 questions/page. First available competition selected automatically. Name · Year · Position/exam; desktop ellipsis and tooltip; phone labels wrap. Desktop Ghost trigger visible at rest; hover/focus feedback; phones use an overlay drawer. Empty competition list shows a message only; navigation failure offers manual Retry. Interface: pt-BR and en. No additional routes. Exact breakpoint, data source and locale controls require technical validation.
notes.screen-inventory:
**Current inventory — 21 variants**
Core: unanswered, list end, selected, correct, incorrect, question loading, empty list, load failure, submitting, submission failure/uncertainty, middle/last page, long content, empty competitions and navigation failure.
Studies: narrow expanded/collapsed, hover, keyboard focus, phone closed/open overlay, navigation loading. Component studies: no-hover rail, localized phone, footer boundaries, tooltip and long-option feedback. Six owner decisions resolved. Mid-Fidelity approved; High-Fidelity selects representative scenarios; component specimens are not separate workspace variants.
notes.user-flows:
**Current flows — v0.1.0**
Entry -> first available item -> questions in original exam order; empty competitions -> message only; list failure -> manual Retry.
Select -> Answer -> pending -> confirmed and locked OR not confirmed (retain selection; safe retry without duplicate evaluation).
Page/competition change -> discard answers; page scroll resets. Exit -> discard. Desktop collapsed trigger stays visible; hover/focus adds feedback; phone opens overlay drawer; dismissal preserves context. The Ghost trigger stays visible on all input devices. Preserve context on collapse/expand. Portuguese and English interface. Technical validation remains.
